description: The decks /draw draws from (docs/FEATURES.md section 12.4, rulings R67 and R68), written by tools/decks-gen/gen.py. A deck is named by its name or an alias; cards are listed in the server's order, and a card may be in a deck more than once. A card is `<suit>-<rank>` or a card outside the suits (extras). orientation: each card drawn is also upright or reversed. naming: `of` reads "queen of cups", `suit_rank` "pine bright", `suit_number` "dots 5" (the rank's short form). glyphs: the Unicode character of a card where it has one, drawn beside its words. english: the English name of every card, which the server writes into the fallback text; clients take their words from their own wording files.
